versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: The word of the Lord also came unto me, saying,
controles.livre: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּית־הַמֶּ֖רִי אַתָּ֣ה יֹשֵׁ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֵינַיִם֩ לָהֶ֨ם לִרְא֜וֹת וְלֹ֣א רָא֗וּ אָזְנַ֨יִם לָהֶ֤ם לִשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽם׃

controles.web: Son of man, you dwell in the midst of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.
controles.kjv: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
controles.livre: Filho do homem, tu habitas em meio de uma casa rebelde, os quais têm olhos para ver mas não veem, têm ouvidos para ouvir, mas não ouvem; pois eles são uma casa rebelde.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ כְּלֵ֣י גוֹלָ֔ה וּגְלֵ֥ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְגָלִ֨יתָ מִמְּקוֹמְךָ֜ אֶל־מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם אוּלַ֣י יִרְא֔וּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: Therefore, you son of man, prepare your stuff for moving, and move by day in their sight; and you shall move from your place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
controles.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
controles.livre: Portanto tu, filho do homem, prepara-te bagagem de partida, e parte-te de dia diante dos olhos deles; e tu partirás de teu lugar para outro lugar diante dos olhos deles; pode ser que vejam, ainda que eles sejam uma casa rebelde.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ כֵלֶ֜יךָ כִּכְלֵ֥י גוֹלָ֛ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֗ה תֵּצֵ֤א בָעֶ֨רֶב֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמוֹצָאֵ֖י גּוֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall bring out your stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for moving; and you shall go out yourself at even in their sight, as when men go out into exile.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
controles.livre: Assim tirarás tuas bagagem, como bagagem de partida, durante dia diante de seus olhos; então tu sairás à tarde diante de seu olhos, como quem sai para se partirem.

versos.hebraico: לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם חֲתָר־לְךָ֣ בַקִּ֑יר וְהוֹצֵאתָ֖ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your stuff out that way.
controles.kjv: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
controles.livre: Diante de seus olhos cava um buraco na parede, e tira por ele a bagagem .

versos.hebraico: לְעֵ֨ינֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא פָּנֶ֣יךָ תְכַסֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־מוֹפֵ֥ת נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark; you shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land: for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.
controles.kjv: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
controles.livre: Diante de seus olhos os levarás sobre teus ombros, ao anoitecer os tirarás; cobrirás teu rosto, para que não vejas a terra; pois eu fiz de ti por sinal à casa de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וָאַ֣עַשׂ כֵּן֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּיתִי֒ כֵּ֠לַי הוֹצֵ֜אתִי כִּכְלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבָעֶ֛רֶב חָתַֽרְתִּי־לִ֥י בַקִּ֖יר בְּיָ֑ד בָּעֲלָטָ֥ה הוֹצֵ֛אתִי עַל־כָּתֵ֥ף נָשָׂ֖אתִי לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: I did so as I was commanded: I brought out my stuff by day, as stuff for removing, and in the even I dug through the wall with my hand; I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
controles.kjv: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
controles.livre: E eu fiz assim como me foi mandado; tirei minha bagagem de dia, como bagagem de partida, e à tarde cavei um buraco na parede com a mão; tirei-os de noite, e os levei sobre os ombros diante dos olhos deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֥קֶר לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: And in the morning came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,
controles.livre: E veio a mim palavra do SENHOR pela manhã, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲלֹ֨א אָמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֛יךָ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי מָ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, What are you doing?
controles.kjv: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
controles.livre: Filho do homem, por acaso a casa de Israel, aquela casa rebelde, não te perguntou: O que estás fazendo?

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֑ה הַנָּשִׂ֞יא הַמַּשָּׂ֤א הַזֶּה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְכָל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה בְתוֹכָֽם׃

controles.web: Say to them, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.
controles.kjv: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
controles.livre: Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: esta revelação é para o príncipe em Jerusalém, e para toda a casa de Israel que está em meio dela.

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י מֽוֹפֶתְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתִי כֵּ֚ן יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם בַּגּוֹלָ֥ה בַשְּׁבִ֖י יֵלֵֽכוּ׃

controles.web: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done to them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.
controles.kjv: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
controles.livre: Dize: Eu sou vosso sinal; tal como eu fiz, assim se fará a eles; serão removidos; irão em cativeiro.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכָ֜ם אֶל־כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה וְיֵצֵ֔א בַּקִּ֥יר יַחְתְּר֖וּ לְה֣וֹצִיא ב֑וֹ פָּנָ֣יו יְכַסֶּ֔ה יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִרְאֶ֥ה לַעַ֛יִן ה֖וּא אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: The prince who is among them shall bear on his shoulder in the dark, and shall go out: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, because he shall not see the land with his eyes.
controles.kjv: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
controles.livre: E o príncipe que está entre eles, levará nos ombros sua bagagem de noite, e sairá; na parede cavarão uma abertura para saírem por ela; cobrirá seu rosto para não ver com seus olhos a terra.

versos.hebraico: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצֽוּדָתִ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤וֹ בָבֶ֨לָה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְאוֹתָ֥הּ לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃

controles.web: My net also will I spread on him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
controles.kjv: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
controles.livre: Também estenderei minha rede sobre ele, e ele será preso em meu laço, e eu o levarei à Babilônia, à terra de caldeus; porém ele não a verá, ainda que morrerá ali.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סְבִיבֹתָ֥יו עזרה וְכָל־אֲגַפָּ֖יו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְכָל־ר֑וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
controles.kjv: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
controles.livre: E a todos os que estiverem ao redor dele para ajudá-lo, e a todas as suas tropas espalharei a todos os ventos, e desembainharei espada atrás deles.

versos.hebraico: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בַּהֲפִיצִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

controles.web: They shall know that I am Yahweh, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.
controles.kjv: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
controles.livre: Assim saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu os espalhar entre as nações, e os dispersar pelas terras.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹתַרְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר מֵחֶ֖רֶב מֵרָעָ֣ב וּמִדָּ֑בֶר לְמַ֨עַן יְסַפְּר֜וּ אֶת־כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם בַּגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Porém deixarei alguns poucos sobreviventes da espada, da fome, e da pestilência, para que contem todas as suas abominações entre as nações para onde forem; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
controles.livre: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם לַחְמְךָ֖ בְּרַ֣עַשׁ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּמֵימֶ֕יךָ בְּרָגְזָ֥ה וּבִדְאָגָ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness;
controles.kjv: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
controles.livre: Filho do homem, come teu pão com tremor, e bebe tua água com estremecimento e com ansiedade;

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֡רֶץ כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַחְמָם֙ בִּדְאָגָ֣ה יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּמֵֽימֵיהֶ֖ם בְּשִׁמָּמ֣וֹן יִשְׁתּ֑וּ לְמַ֜עַן תֵּשַׁ֤ם אַרְצָהּ֙ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ מֵחֲמַ֖ס כָּֽל־הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: and tell the people of the land, Thus says the Lord Yahweh concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.
controles.kjv: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord God of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
controles.livre: E dize ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS sobre os moradores de Jerusalém, e sobre a terra de Israel: Comerão seu pão com ansiedade, e com espanto beberão sua água; porque sua terra será desolada de seu conteúdo, por causa da violência de todos os que nela habitam.

versos.hebraico: וְהֶעָרִ֤ים הַנּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת֙ תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E as cidades habitadas serão desoladas, e a terra se tornará em deserto; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
controles.livre: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם מָֽה־הַמָּשָׁ֤ל הַזֶּה֙ לָכֶ֔ם עַל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יַֽאַרְכוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְאָבַ֖ד כָּל־חָזֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?
controles.kjv: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
controles.livre: Filho do homem, que ditado é este que vós tendes vós terra de Israel, que diz: Os dias se prolongarão, e toda visão perecerá?

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִשְׁבַּ֨תִּי֙ אֶת־הַמָּשָׁ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִמְשְׁל֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ ע֖וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֚י אִם־דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קָֽרְבוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וּדְבַ֖ר כָּל־חָזֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Tell them therefore, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but tell them, The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
controles.kjv: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord God; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
controles.livre: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei cessar este ditado, e não usarão mais esta frase em Israel. Ao invés disso, dize-lhes: Os dias chegaram, e o cumprimento de toda visão.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד כָּל־חֲז֥וֹן שָׁ֖וְא וּמִקְסַ֣ם חָלָ֑ק בְּת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: For there shall be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
controles.kjv: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
controles.livre: Porque não haverá mais uma visão falsa sequer, nem haverá adivinhação lisonjeira no meio da casa de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה לֹ֥א תִמָּשֵׁ֖ךְ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י בִֽימֵיכֶ֞ם בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֗רִי אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֔יו נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

controles.web: For I am Yahweh; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: For I am the Lord: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: Pois eu, o SENHOR, falarei; a palavra que eu falar se cumprirá; não se prolongará mais; porque em vossos dias, ó casa rebelde, falarei a palavra e a cumprirei, diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
controles.livre: Também veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים הֶחָז֛וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא חֹזֶ֖ה לְיָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וּלְעִתִּ֥ים רְחוֹק֖וֹת ה֥וּא נִבָּֽא׃

controles.web: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he sees is for many day to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.
controles.kjv: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
controles.livre: Filho do homem, eis que os da casa de Israel dizem: A visão que este vê é para muitos dias, e ele profetiza para tempos distantes.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹא־תִמָּשֵׁ֥ךְ ע֖וֹד כָּל־דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

controles.web: Therefore tell them, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: None of my words shall be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: Por isso dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Nenhuma das minhas palavras se prolongará mais; e palavra que eu falei se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
